title: Detection Engineer
description:
Detection Engineer.
You think like an attacker and build like a defender. At DEFION, you transform real Red Team findings into detection rules that actually catch threats in production.
Where offense meets defense
DEFION has been protecting organizations since 2005. Our Detection Engineering team sits at the intersection of offense and defense: you take findings from real attacker simulations and Red Team exercises and translate them into detection rules that work across SIEM, EDR, and XDR platforms.
You will not just consume threat intelligence; you will generate it and apply it. You work in a multidisciplinary team alongside Red Teamers, Blue Teamers, and threat hunters in our Barcelona office (or remotely).
What you will do
Design, develop, and fine-tune detection rules in SIEM, EDR, and XDR platforms (Sentinel, CrowdStrike, Cortex, Splunk, and more)
Analyze results from attacker simulations to identify weaknesses in security controls
Develop detection and mitigation strategies for emerging threats using MITRE ATT&CK
Automate and optimize processes with Python, PowerShell, and Bash scripts
What you bring
Must have:
1-2 years of experience as Detection Engineer or SOC Analyst creating/optimizing alerts in SIEM/EDR
Knowledge of KQL (Kusto Query Language) and/or CQL (CrowdStrike Query Language)
Deep knowledge of Windows logs, telemetry, and event analysis for proactive threat detection
Strong understanding of adversary TTPs based on MITRE ATT&CK
Scripting skills in Bash, Python, or PowerShell
Knowledge of Windows and Linux system administration, TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS
Purple-team mindset: think like an adversary, enhance defensive capabilities
Clear communication in English for international team collaboration
Nice to have:
Cybersecurity certifications or a master's degree in a related field
Degree in Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related field
Why you will love working here
Red + Blue collaboration
Work closely with Red Team and Blue Team. Access to EDR, SIEMs, threat intelligence, and more.
Continuous training
Internal and external training, certifications, and annual conference attendance.
Career plan
A personalized professional development plan tailored to your interests and growth goals.
Barcelona office or remote
Flexible remote work or a comfortable office in central Barcelona. Summer reduced hours.
Health + benefits
Private health insurance, flexible compensation (meals, transport, childcare, training).
International team
Young, dynamic, and international team with an excellent work environment and work-life balance.

title: IT Security Internship
description:
IT Security Internship.
Your graduation project, but with real impact. At DEFION, you work alongside security specialists who hack for a living. Your research matters, your ideas count, and lunch is on us.
Learn by doing, surrounded by experts
DEFION started as a group of friends who loved tech. That culture is still alive: informal, curious, and expert-level. As an intern, you are part of the team from day one. You join stand-ups, shadow specialists, and dive into a real challenge.
Together we design your internship assignment to meet your course requirements while keeping it genuinely useful. Think: building a pentest tool, comparing security tooling for CI/CD pipelines, or researching new attack techniques. If your project wraps up early, there is internal training to keep you busy.
What you will do
Work on your graduation assignment, with real challenges and guidance from senior specialists
Shadow pentesters, researchers, and SOC analysts at work every day
Participate in your team's stand-up meetings
Start internal training if your project runs ahead of schedule
What you bring
Student at a university or university of applied sciences (technical or IT subject)
Final-year student looking for a graduation assignment
Independent, driven, motivated, and ambitious
Certificate of good conduct (VOG) or ability to obtain one
You thrive in an informal work environment
Why you will love interning here
€500/month allowance
Your effort deserves fair compensation. You also get a laptop for the duration of your internship.
Learn from the best
Work alongside ethical hackers, researchers, and SOC analysts. Their specialties also include FIFA and table tennis.

title: Medior SOC Analyst
description:
Medior SOC Analyst.
You are the sharp eye that separates real threats from noise. In our SOC, you work with cutting-edge Microsoft Security tech, side by side with threat hunters and incident responders.
Our SOC: technical, pragmatic, collaborative
DEFION operates an international twin-SOC model. The Dutch SOC focuses on Microsoft Security technologies (Defender, Sentinel, Azure), while the Spanish SOC specializes in CrowdStrike. We are integrating both to protect clients worldwide with combined expertise.
Our SOC is highly technical and pragmatic, with plenty of humor between serious incidents. You will collaborate with analysts, threat hunters, ethical hackers, and DFIR specialists to examine and resolve incidents from multiple angles. This is a hybrid role with on-call rotations for 24/7 client coverage.
What you will do
Investigate and follow up on security incidents in Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Sentinel
Interpret alerts and translate them into clear reports and recommended actions for clients
Contribute to detection improvements, threat intelligence gathering, and playbook tuning
Support client onboarding and offboarding processes
Guide junior analysts and collaborate with threat hunters and incident responders across borders
Actively contribute ideas to make SOC processes smarter, faster, and better
What you bring
Must have:
Minimum 3 years of experience in a Security Operations Center
Minimum 3 years of hands-on incident handling with Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Sentinel
MBO-4 or HBO level of working and thinking
Full proficiency in Dutch and English
Clear communication, structured working style, calm under pressure
Nice to have:
Basic knowledge of Azure (AZ-900 certification)
SC-200 and/or SC-900 certification
Experience with CrowdStrike Falcon EDR (relevant for international SOC collaboration)
Why you will love working here
Competitive salary + lease car
Market-competitive salary, lease car or mobility allowance, 24 vacation days.
Close-knit SOC team
A highly skilled team where knowledge sharing is natural and humor is never far away.
Training and certifications
Continuous development opportunities to keep your skills sharp and current.
Real impact
Freedom to work independently and make a genuine difference within a growing MDR service.
Hybrid + free lunch
Flexible hybrid work with modern tools. Free lunch at the office, weekly workout, and a game room.
Social events + study trips
Monthly social events, team outings, and an unforgettable annual study trip.

title: New Business Developer
description:
New Business Developer.
Not an account manager who maintains existing relationships. You are the hunter who opens new doors with C-level and IT decision-makers, taking cold contacts all the way to closed deals.
Build the client portfolio of a fast-growing security company
DEFION Security protects more than 1,000 organisations, including names like AFAS, AZ Alkmaar and SURF. With 20+ years of security expertise and 100+ certified specialists, we are one of the leading managed security providers in the Netherlands. And we are growing fast.
As a New Business Developer, you are at the heart of that growth. You work closely with our Prevent, Detect, Respond and Governance teams to match prospects to the security solution that truly fits. Pentesting, security monitoring, incident response: you understand the portfolio and translate it into the language of the client.
What you will do
Actively bring in new clients for DEFION's portfolio: pentesting, security monitoring and incident response
Open doors yourself: leverage your network and take cold contacts from first call to closed deal
Understand risk profiles and match prospects to the right Managed Services (Prevent, Detect, Respond and Governance)
Prepare high-quality proposals and quotes: clear, compelling and client-focused
Organise workshops, lunches and masterclasses for prospects and existing relationships
Attend sector events to actively build new contacts and identify opportunities
We also expect you to:
Make technically complex topics accessible to non-technical stakeholders
Stay committed to a deal: long sales cycles do not put you off
Know when to bring in a colleague or specialist to win a client
Embrace the unknown: finding and converting new clients energises you
What you bring
Must have:
Proven sales experience in cybersecurity: building pipeline and closing deals
Experience with managed security solutions: MDR and pentesting
University or university of applied sciences level of education
Strong command of Dutch and English
Independent and proactive: you do not need daily supervision
Results-driven: you dislike losing a deal and do everything to win the next one
Genuine interest in cybersecurity: you keep developing your knowledge
Nice to have:
Broad understanding of the Dutch cybersecurity landscape and relevant legislation such as NIS2, DORA and ISO 27001
Experience with complex B2B services with longer sales cycles
Network with C-level decision-makers in sectors that still lack adequate security solutions
Why you will love working here
Competitive salary + bonus
A salary that matches your experience, plus an attractive bonus scheme based on your results.
Lease car, laptop and phone
A lease car of your choice, plus a top smartphone and laptop from day one.
Grow with us
We are scaling fast. Want to grow into a bigger role? We will map that path together.
Flexible hybrid work
Flexible schedule, frequently at client sites, regularly at our Zoetermeer office. You decide what works best.
Team spirit and culture
Daily lunch buffet, team outings, monthly get-togethers and study trips. A close-knit team that works and celebrates together.
Permanent contract path
Start with a one-year contract. If the fit is right, a permanent contract follows.

title: Senior Security Specialist
description:
Senior Security Specialist.
You have years of experience breaking things that should not break. At DEFION, you get to shape your own role: tech lead, trainer, consultant, or deep specialist. Your call.
Your expertise, your direction
At DEFION, we work mostly with short projects of one to two weeks. That means you will work with many different organizations and application types in rapid succession. Some weeks it is a cloud environment, the next it is Active Directory, then a mobile app. Variety is built into the role.
But beyond that, you shape this position yourself. Want to go deep on red teaming? Become a tech lead? Develop tooling? Train juniors? Advise clients on security strategy? We create the role that fits your strengths and ambitions.
What you will do
Conduct a full range of offensive security tests: web applications, infrastructure, cloud, mobile, and more
Document findings in detailed reports and present results directly to clients
Specialize in areas that match your interests: cloud security, red teaming, infrastructure, or security consulting/governance
Provide security training, advise prospects, and mentor juniors and interns
Develop and improve internal tooling when that is where your passion lies
What you bring
Must have:
Proven experience with pentesting and security assessments
Broad IT knowledge: programming, networking, databases, Linux internals
Knowledge of Cloud Security (AWS/Azure), Active Directory, mobile app security, OAuth/SAML, cryptography
Experience with tools like Burp Suite, Nessus, or Nmap
Strong knowledge of common vulnerabilities (XSS, CSRF, SQLi) and how to mitigate them
A bachelor's or master's degree in a technical field (HBO/WO level)
Ability to communicate technical findings clearly, both verbally and in writing
Nice to have:
Published CVEs to your name
Experience in security consulting or governance advisory
Why you will love working here
Competitive package
Competitive salary, permanent contract after probation, mobility budget or lease car, high-end laptop and phone.
Personal training budget
Invest in certifications, courses, or conferences. Grow technically and personally at your own pace.
Diverse projects
Short engagements (1-2 weeks) across many organizations and technologies. Never the same challenge twice.
Shape your role
Tech lead, trainer, tool builder, consultant: you decide where to take your career at DEFION.
Great home base
Game room, gym, daily lunch buffet, flexible hours. Parties, social events, and annual study trips.
Nerdy colleagues
Super social, tech-obsessed, down-to-earth. We share knowledge regularly and have fun while doing it.

title: SOC Analyst
description:
SOC Analyst.
You do not just categorize alerts. You investigate, trace back to the source, assess impact, and respond. At DEFION's Barcelona SOC, every threat gets the attention it deserves.
Investigate, respond, protect
DEFION's MDR and Managed Threat Intelligence services are expanding internationally. As a SOC Analyst in Barcelona, you join the DRTI team to detect, analyze, and mitigate cyber threats for our clients. You work with CrowdStrike, Microsoft Sentinel, and other leading SIEM/EDR platforms.
This is not a checkbox role. You will investigate alerts thoroughly, apply threat intelligence to anticipate attacks, contain threats, and write clear reports with actionable recommendations. You collaborate with Red Team, Blue Team, and detection engineers to keep getting better.
What you will do
Monitor and analyze security alerts in EDR/SIEM platforms, identifying suspicious activity and assessing origin and scope
Analyze threat intelligence to anticipate potential attacks against clients
Respond to detected threats: contain, mitigate, minimize impact
Write reports and client notifications with clear findings and recommendations
Improve detection rules, develop procedures and playbooks, automate tasks with scripting
Participate in client meetings for ongoing reviews and onboarding support
What you bring
Must have:
At least 1 year of experience analyzing security alerts in SIEM and/or EDR platforms (CrowdStrike, Sentinel, Cortex, Splunk, Elastic, etc.)
Knowledge of Windows and Linux system administration
Solid understanding of networks and protocols: TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS
Scripting skills in Bash, Python, or PowerShell
Analytical thinking: ability to correlate events, detect attack patterns, and solve complex problems
Clear communication in English for international collaboration
Availability for 24/7 on-call rotation

Cybersecurity certifications or a master's degree
